name: capture.drop
description: Forgets a capture and the pasted link it became: the sender deleted the message on Instagram (Platform Terms). Internal: packages/connect's webhook, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with c as (delete from brandbase.captures x where x.id = :id returning x.id, x.brand_id), p as (delete from brandbase.pasted_links l using c where l.id = c.id and l.brand_id = c.brand_id returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('dropped', (select count(*) from c), 'pasted', (select count(*) from p)) as result
